hosted.note: W5 owns hosted proof; no provider, token, VM or hosted store was accessed

design_decisions.projection_writer: intraday_snapshot_projection.project_reconciled_minute_snapshots is the only minute snapshot writer; it takes pass results, re-reads rows via hash-verified read_reconciled_rows, and calls append_normalized_records(dataset='tw_price_1m'). reconcile_day invokes it at the end of a write=True run when snapshot_store is given. pipeline.persist_latest_market_snapshots exclusion is untouched.
design_decisions.snapshot_semantics: point event_time = bar_end; snapshot observed_at = max bar_availability_ts of the projected rows (real reconciled availability, not bar_end); store keeps the latest max_closes (60) bars per (symbol, dataset)
design_decisions.feature_lag: FeatureDefinition gains availability_lag_unit (days|minutes), min_availability_lag and cross_session (default false); min_availability_lag_days retained for compatibility
design_decisions.frequency_table_home: services/registry/strategy_artifact.BAR_FREQUENCY_DATASETS (requirement_state keeps a mirrored literal to avoid a registry import cycle at module scope)

gaps: The runtime wiring of reconcile_day(snapshot_store=...) into a scheduled/hosted reconcile run is not exercised: the only repository caller is the read-only report script (write=False). Hosted scheduling belongs to K2/W5.

Append-only store: a day already projected and later re-quarantined is not withdrawn from the minute snapshot (reconcile removes the pass record, so loaders/read_reconciled_rows stop serving it, but the latest-snapshot log keeps the earlier points until overwritten). Needs a tombstone design.

5m/15m/30m/60m latest snapshots are not projected (only the 1m dataset is written; coarser frequencies return 404 from snapshots/latest); aggregation is served by services/research/intraday_bars.load_bars.
